title: Tea And Soju - A C-drama Podcast
author: Liliana
description: Welcome to Tea & Soju, your C-drama hangout! I’m Liliana, and this is where we come together to chat about C-dramas, share our thoughts, fangirl over our favourites, and occasionally question our life choices after starting yet another drama. So grab your tea, pour your soju, and let’s chat dramas! 🍵
